observation.command:
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  if curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:37315/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "boards responding at attempt $i"; break; fi
  sleep 55
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "boards direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:37315/ 2>/dev/null || echo "boards not yet"
echo "=== boards log ==="; tail -5 /tmp/serve-boards.log
free -m | sed -n '2p'
